Participants received reward for each button press they conducted in the 3-sec interval
Physical effort was thereby used as a measure of motivation ( ).

instructions.value: Participants learned the task during an eight-trial practice version, then completed a test run to determine their maximum button-press speed. On each trial, they viewed a cue for 3 seconds indicating whether the reward would be money or cigarettes and the reward level (0, 1, 10, or 100), then pressed a button as many times as possible during a 3-second response interval to obtain the reward. Each button press earned reward, with the amount determined by the number of presses multiplied by the reward level. They received acoustic feedback for each press and feedback on the reward earned and cumulative total after each trial.

spans.text: Before entering the scanner, participants completed a practice version of the task (eight trials) to learn how to perform it.
